settings_auth_ui.help_auth0: Auth0 adds custom claims under a namespaced URL like "https://cooktrace.app/roles". Leave the admin claim blank for now and contact your tenant admin to set up a rule that exposes role membership.
settings_auth_ui.help_authelia: Authelia's issuer URL is the root URL where Authelia is served, with no path suffix.
settings_auth_ui.help_authentik: Issuer URL is the "OpenID Configuration Issuer" shown on the Provider page in Authentik. Make sure your Application uses an OAuth2/OIDC Provider and you've added the redirect URI shown above to its allowed list.
settings_auth_ui.help_google: Google's issuer URL is fixed. Group/role claims are not available with standard scopes, so admin role mapping is hidden for this provider; promote Google users manually after first login.
settings_auth_ui.help_keycloak: Add a "groups" mapper to your client's default scope so the groups claim is included in the ID token.
settings_auth_ui.help_pocket_id: Pocket ID uses passkeys for primary auth, so your users won't need a password at the IdP either. Add the redirect URI shown above to the OIDC client in Pocket ID admin.
settings_auth_ui.help_custom: Any OpenID Connect 1.0 compliant provider that supports Authorization Code Flow + PKCE + Discovery should work here.
settings_auth_ui.confirm_delete_provider: Delete provider "{name}"? Linked users will lose this sign-in option.
settings_auth_ui.confirm_disable_password: Disable password login? Users without an OIDC link will not be able to sign in until you re-enable it. RECOVERY_TOKEN will still work.
settings_auth_ui.um_required_desc_html: Single Sign-On is scoped to user accounts, so User Management has to be enabled first. Set it up in Settings > User Management, then come back here.
settings_auth_ui.admin_only_desc: Only admins can configure identity providers. If you need this access, ask the admin of this CookTrace instance to promote your account.
settings_auth_ui.providers_desc: Authentik, Keycloak, Pocket ID, Authelia, Auth0, Google, etc. Users sign in with their existing identity provider.
settings_auth_ui.env_badge_title: Configured via environment variables. Edit your .env / docker-compose to change.
settings_auth_ui.empty_html: No providers configured yet. Click + Add Provider to set one up, or define them in your .env using the OIDC_* variables (see README).
settings_auth_ui.client_secret_keep: Client Secret (leave blank to keep existing)
settings_auth_ui.redirect_hint_html: Must match exactly what your IdP has configured. The path is /api/auth/oidc/callback/<provider-id> under your CookTrace base URL.
settings_auth_ui.auto_register_desc: Allow anyone with an account at this IdP to create a brand-new CookTrace account on first sign-in. OFF = admin must invite first. Leave OFF for shared IdPs (Google, work SSO) unless you actually want blanket onboarding.
settings_auth_ui.inactive_hint: Inactive providers won't show on the Login page.
settings_auth_ui.admin_group_claim_hint_html: Name of the claim that lists user groups. Common: groups.
settings_auth_ui.admin_group_value_hint: If a user's groups claim contains this value, they're set to admin on each login.
settings_auth_ui.password_login_desc_html: When off, users sign in only via OIDC. Recovery still works via the RECOVERY_TOKEN env var.
